note: Every public project in github.com/cyberdudeuk. Summaries are written from each project's own README. Status is as each project states it. tools/discover.py flags any public repository missing from this list.

projects.name: AI Capability Governance and Implementation
projects.summary: Guidance you can act on for governing AI and AI agents in public services: a six-level human review model, evidence and transparency record generators, an agent registry pattern and a weekly signals scan.
projects.audience: Anyone using, buying, approving or assuring AI in public services

projects.name: DCAT-AP-UK
projects.summary: A proposed application profile for describing UK public sector datasets and data services, so they can be found, judged and shared across every catalogue. Under review; the endorsed model remains the cross-government metadata exchange model.
projects.audience: Catalogue owners, metadata leads and data architects

projects.name: Data Asset Management capability playbooks
projects.summary: Step-by-step guidance on data governance, data cataloguing and data quality for critical data assets in UK government, built around the data asset management policy.
projects.audience: Data owners, stewards, catalogue managers and data leaders

projects.name: Public Sector Data Quality Commons
projects.summary: A free, open hub and toolkit for data quality in the public sector: check data, find the frameworks and standards that apply, learn, use AI safely and share what works.
projects.audience: Anyone responsible for data quality, from first steps to automation

projects.name: GitHub Repos Asset Catalogue
projects.summary: Before you build it, look for it. Every UK public sector code project on GitHub in one place, explained in plain English, so you can find work that already exists and decide whether to reuse it.
projects.audience: Policy leads, service owners, data leaders and engineers

projects.name: The Knowledge Web
projects.summary: A navigable, ontology-backed map of a body of work on UK government data standards, governance and knowledge management, delivered as one self-contained file that works offline.
projects.audience: People mapping or navigating a large body of knowledge
projects.how: Download dist/the-web.html from the repository and open it in a browser

projects.name: Plainspoken
projects.summary: A phone-first speaking coach for anyone who speaks at work, with situations drawn from public sector settings: a daily 20-minute routine, event preparation, speak-and-score, role-play and a live cue card.
projects.audience: Anyone who wants to speak more clearly at work
projects.licence: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 code (see repository for content)

projects.name: BHM 2026 Hub: Honouring Our Communities
projects.summary: A hub celebrating Black and Black-Mixed history, heritage and cultures, Africa and the diaspora, built for Black History Month 2026 in the UK and designed to run all year.
projects.audience: Colleagues across the public sector and the wider community

projects.name: Public sector MCP server
projects.summary: An experiment in building a Model Context Protocol server for public sector data.
projects.how: An early experiment with no published site: see the repository

excluded.why: Forks and private repositories are not listed.

ways_in._note: Suggested starting points per level, chosen by the owner. Edit freely.
